case_name: Over budget or beyond the free tier
title: Estimate Exceeds Hard Credit Budget
tests: Checks that an over-budget estimate produces a clear budget warning and no generation, rather than an unauthorized cheaper substitute.

got.question:
I didn't make the clip. The estimate is 90 credits, which is three times your 30-credit limit, so I stopped as you asked. No job was started and no credits were spent.

Here's what I would have made: a 5-second, 16:9 clip with no audio, using the free plan's video model (ltx-2.5 at 480p), of a paper boat floating down a stream.

A shorter clip would probably cost less. ltx-2.5 can make clips as sh

must_haves.item: The response states that the 90-credit estimate exceeds the 30-credit budget.
must_haves.why: First agent message: 'The estimate is 90 credits, which is three times your 30-credit limit, so I stopped.'

must_haves.item: The response clearly says generation has not started.
must_haves.why: Agent said 'No job was started and no credits were spent' and later 'Nothing was created.'

must_haves.item: No clip or substitute asset is delivered.
must_haves.why: No clip was produced. A shorter clip was offered only as an option, and the agent made nothing when the user declined.

reply.summary: The agent met all three must-haves: it stopped because the estimate was over budget, confirmed nothing was started, and delivered no clip.
